text:
Ana (AE): Heads up — Prospect 'ClearHarbor' ready to kick off SSO/SCIM POC. Their legal + infra teams listed blockers: data residency, KMS, and a firm pricing for Dedicated if we need reserved capacity. Can SE/PS/security triage? Link: https://redwood.example/com/pipe/clearharbor-poc :wave:
Mike (Solutions Eng): On it. Quick Qs: do they want SP-initiated or IdP-initiated SAML? Encrypted assertions? Which IdP (Okta/Azure/ADFS)? Also need SCIM detail: full provisioning vs just groups, and whether they require SCIM PATCH/delta or only bulk /Users endpoint.
Sarah (PS): Also need expected QPS and concurrent sessions to price Dedicated vs hosted. If they need 99.9% SLA + reserved GPUs, will need a monthly commit estimate. Rough numbers ok for now.
Ana (AE): They said IdP is mostly Okta but might include a few Azure tenants. Prefer SP-initiated but will accept both. SCIM: they want user + group provisioning, group->role mapping for RBAC. They flagged domain ownership: multiple verified domains (corp.clearharbor.com + partner.clearharbor.com).
Mike (Solutions Eng): Notes for config:
- SAML: support for HTTP-POST and HTTP-Redirect bindings, we support AES-256 encrypted assertions if needed. Need their metadata XML. Example snippet they can paste into IdP:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://api.redwood.example/metadata/clearharbor">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="false">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://clearharbor.redwood.example/api/sso/callback"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
- SCIM: we support SCIM v2.0 with PATCH (RFC 7644). Example PATCH to add group membership:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/123
Content-Type: application/json
[ { "op": "add", "path": "members", "value": [{"value":"user-789"}] } ]
```
Mike (Solutions Eng): We also can do delta syncs; default rate-limits are 60 reqs/min per tenant but we can relax behind Dedicated. Will note for pricing.
Sarah (PS): Pricing ballpark: for a 2-week POC on hosted -> no charge aside from usage. If they commit to Dedicated (4x A10G equiv) expect ~$25k/mo baseline + overage. If they need multi-tenant isolation + KMS/HSM + 12-mo commit we can discount. Need final expected token throughput to firm up.
Jurgen (Security): Legal/security flags I saw in questionnaire: data residency (EU/US), KMS integration (bring-your-own-key), SOC2 Type II, pen-test reports, vulnerability disclosure, audit log retention, and admin access controls (RBAC). Quick answers we can provide: SOC2 Type II yes (link), we support BYOK via KMS, audit logs retained 90 days by default (longer on request), pen-test cadence annually — we can attach recent report. For PII concerns: recommend Private deployment (VPC) if they require strict controls.
Jurgen (Security): Also need to confirm: do they require SCIM provisioning logs to be redacted? If yes, we can enable attribute redaction for logs.
Ana (AE): Legal wants canned answers for questionnaire items 3.1–3.7 by EOD Thurs. Can we assemble short answers + attachments (SOC2 cert, KMS whitepaper, pen-test summary)?
Mike (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the technical appendix: SAML metadata example, SCIM PATCH support, rate limits, group mapping docs. Will drop in the shared drive by EOD.
Sarah (PS): I'll build pricing scenarios: hosted POC (free credits) vs Dedicated 3-tier. Will include monthly commit numbers and term discounts.
Jurgen (Security): I'll upload the compliance pack (SOC2, ISO summary, pen-test redaction) to the drive and add a short blurb about audit logs + BYOK integration steps.
deploy-bot: POC workspace created: https://console.redwood.example/tenancy/poc-clearharbor (workspace id: poc-clear-202405). Invite sent to clearharbor@clearharbor.com :white_check_mark:
Ana (AE): Awesome — can we confirm timeline: POC kickoff next Tuesday, 2-week run, final decision window in 30 days. Owner: Mike for SE tasks, Sarah for pricing, Jurgen for security.
Mike (Solutions Eng): Confirmed for kickoff next Tue. Need their Okta metadata and a sample user CSV for initial provisioning test. Can someone ask them to attach to the drive?
Ana (AE): I'll ping them now and request metadata + CSV. Tagging @clearharbor_admin in email.
Sarah (PS): Thx — I'll prep the pricing doc and post it to the drive when ready.
Jurgen (Security): Adding a short mitigation plan for any blocker legal flags. If they insist on on-prem storage we should propose Private deploy timeline (approx 6–8 weeks).
Ana (AE): Perfect. Thanks all :pray:
Mike (Solutions Eng): Will post the tech appendix + quick config checklist. :eyes:
Sarah (PS): Will post pricing scenarios. :money_with_wings:
Jurgen (Security): Uploaded compliance pack to the drive: https://drive.example.com/open?id=abc123 (added redacted pen-test).
Ana (AE): Closing loop — we'll consolidate answers and send to ClearHarbor legal by Thu EOD.
Mike (Solutions Eng): Quick note — if they want SCIM group->role mapping examples, here's a mapping snippet we use internally: `group.name -> role:developer|ops|admin`. Happy to tailor.
Ana (AE): Great — moving to action items.
(threads ends)
